pub fn try_new(
        declared: DeclaredFiniteFunctor,
        source: ValidatedFiniteCategory,
        target: ValidatedFiniteCategory,
    ) -> Result<Self, FunctorAdmissionError>
ValidatedFiniteFunctor::try_new.obligation: Move raw declaration and two already admitted owned endpoint categories into a private candidate. Binding, exact map domains/images, both boundaries, actual identities and every source composite must all return Ok in that order before releasing the candidate. Any typed error returns no certificate; no rollback of caller/global effects is needed because these are immutable internal checks.

ValidatedFiniteFunctor::declared.obligation: Borrow immutable raw declaration inside admitted certificate; no mutable access/deserialization bypass exists.

ValidatedFiniteFunctor::source.obligation: Borrow the owned admitted source category.

ValidatedFiniteFunctor::target.obligation: Borrow the owned admitted target category, not the source.

ValidatedFiniteFunctor::on_object.obligation: Delegate exact borrowed lookup to the stored object map; outside-domain identifiers return None.

ValidatedFiniteFunctor::on_morphism.obligation: Delegate exact borrowed lookup to stored morphism map; outside-domain identifiers return None.

ValidatedFiniteFunctor::check_binding.obligation: Reject whitespace-only functor name first, then any mismatch of raw endpoint names against owned admitted endpoints. No reliance on names alone for category laws: actual endpoint objects are owned admitted categories.

ValidatedFiniteFunctor::check_maps.obligation: Ordered key equality enforces exact total object and morphism source domains, excluding missing and extra keys. Then validate every object image and every morphism image against actual admitted target membership, with exact objects/morphisms kind payloads and phase precedence.

ValidatedFiniteFunctor::check_boundaries.obligation: For every actual admitted source arrow, compare actual target boundary of its mapped arrow against both mapped source endpoints. Reject missing or unequal boundaries with the first sorted source arrow name. No silently skipped unknown images.

ValidatedFiniteFunctor::check_identities.obligation: Use each actual source identity binding and actual target identity binding at the mapped object; require a defined expected identity and equal mapped arrow, with exact first object error. No id_ naming assumption in certificate admission.

ValidatedFiniteFunctor::check_compositio.obligation: Build one shared borrowed target-composition view. For every actual admitted source composition row (first,second,result), map both arrows, compose in target in first-then-second order, and require a defined equal image of result. Return first sorted pair error otherwise. Source category admission establishes this table is exactly the composable domain.

check_images.obligation: Private known callsites pass only immutable target object/arrow membership predicates. Scan map values in key order and reject the first nonmember with exact kind/image; no external/public callback is admitted by this helper.

CompositionLookup::new.obligation: Build one borrowed row per sorted unique BTreeMap pair key, without filtering, sorting, owned key copies or changing associations. String and str lexicographic order agree. Immutable borrowing prevents mutation during the view lifetime. This is the prior category-validator lookup moved into a crate-visible shared helper taking the same underlying table directly.

check_identity_law.obligation: Legacy literal id_ naming rule over supplied sorted object mappings. Build the required source identity name; absent mapping yields the exact undefined diagnostic and skips target-name allocation. Only a present mapping builds expected id_target, comparing exact names and reporting mismatch. Empty map is vacuous. This does not check arbitrary category identity labels or source-domain completeness.

check_composition_law.obligation: Use one borrowed view of supplied raw target table and inspect supplied source triples in input order. Missing f, then g, then composite mapping each gives exactly its first missing diagnostic. Otherwise compare explicit target composite with mapped result; absent table row and differing result have distinct exact messages. Empty supplied cases are vacuous, no universal functor law inferred.

data_trait_macro_review.certificate: ValidatedFiniteFunctor owns admitted source/target categories and raw maps in private fields; only try_new can construct it within this source, all typed checks precede Ok. Immutable accessors and structural Clone/PartialEq/Eq/Debug preserve contents without admitting arbitrary raw/deserialized declarations. FunctorAdmissionError exhaustively retains Name, CategoryBinding, MappingDomain(kind), UnknownImage(kind,image), Boundary(morphism), Identity(object) and Composition(first,second). No hidden global state or serde bypass.
data_trait_macro_review.raw_and_traits: DeclaredFiniteFunctor public maps/names remain unchecked; standard derives clone/compare/debug literal data. CompositionTable is the same BTreeMap tuple representation. CatFunctor and ContravariantFunctor have two required map signatures and associated endpoint types; Category has required partial id/src/tgt/compose and Clone/Eq/Debug associated types. All are caller contracts, without default executable bodies or law/purity enforcement. The local root Category is nominally distinct from catalog/legacy/external traits; stale canonical-path prose is removed.
data_trait_macro_review.runtime_and_macros: No own unchecked arithmetic, floating operation, unsafe, unwrap/expect/assert or unguarded index in production. Standard format! and structural derives are reviewed; String/str order, BTreeMap/BTreeSet iteration/get/key equality, Vec collection/get and binary_search_by_key are trusted standard library behavior. Mutable raw public records have no law claim. Allocation exhaustion/compiler/std defects are outside claimed allocator-totality; no external trait/user callback is invoked by certificate admission.

cost_review: Let K bound endpoint/mapping/table cardinalities and L bound relevant string-comparison length. Functor admission has O(o_s+m_s+c_t+(o_s+m_s+c_s) log(K+1)) key comparisons, with string byte costs L explicit. Exact key-domain equality is linear in source map sizes; image/boundary/identity checks use borrowed tree lookups; composition visits exactly the source table rows after building an O(c_t) target view.

Functor check auxiliary storage is O(c_t) borrowed rows and, on first refusal, the required owned error payload. Owned raw declaration/endpoints are moved into the candidate, not deep-cloned in admission loops. Raw builder inserts retain owned key/value storage; structural Clone explicitly costs all record/endpoint data.

Legacy composition diagnostics build O(c_t) borrowed view once and make O(C log(K+1)) queries plus required returned diagnostic bytes for C supplied cases. Legacy identity naming must synthesize id_source and, only if mapping exists, id_target; no target-name allocation on missing-source-identity paths. Other raw coverage/boundary loops use borrowed keys and allocate only returned messages.

Category validator retains its prior O(c+m^3 log(c+1)) associativity comparison bound and O(c+violations) view/output storage, plus other declared map/identity/boundary phases. Shared helper relocation does not add a sorting pass or change the view key/value projection. String lengths, required diagnostic allocations, compiler/std/allocator and finite memory/time remain explicit. No new work budget, benchmark, zero-allocation whole-constructor or allocator-totality promise.

Generic trait signatures and raw diagnostic payload/order remain unchanged. Five currently completed assessment contexts reference either changed source; validator is freshly reassessed, four unchanged-own-source category core/builder/arrow/report assessments receive explicit provider refinement with their own primary/metrics retained.
